title: Cauliflower Cheese Bake
summary: A classic British cauliflower cheese, baked until bubbling with a golden top. Creamy, savoury and comforting, it makes a simple vegetarian dinner with a crisp salad or steamed greens.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets.
Boil the cauliflower for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender, then drain well and spread it in a baking dish.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, whisking to make a smooth paste.
Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth, then simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Remove from the heat and stir in most of the cheddar, the mustard, salt, black pepper and nutmeg until melted and creamy.
Pour the cheese sauce over the cauliflower and gently mix so it is evenly coated.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the olive oil and remaining cheddar, then scatter over the top.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and golden brown on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
